en: Silently, silently, the wonderful gift was given! From Heaven, God imparts his blessing to the people. He came silently. But the meek souls, the people received it while Christ entered in.
nv: doo íitsʼaʼgóó, doo íitsʼaʼgóó, aadeetʼáanii aaíltį́! yáʼąąshdę́ę́ʼ god einíłtíinii diné yeidiyiiʼaah. doo íitsʼaʼígóó níyá; ndi aʼátʼeʼ biiʼ, diné dabinízingóó christ tʼahdii yah aheghááh.

en: Silently, silently, the wonderful present was given! From Heaven God provides his blessing to people. He arrived silently. But the meek souls, mankind received it while Christ entered.
nv: doo íitsʼaʼgóó, doo íitsʼaʼgóó, aadeetʼáanii aaíltį́! yáʼąąshdę́ę́ʼ god einíłtíinii diné yeidiyiiʼaah. doo íitsʼaʼígóó níyá; ndi aʼátʼeʼ biiʼ, diné dabinízingóó christ tʼahdii yah aheghááh.

en: Silently, silently, the wondrous gift was given! From heaven, God passes on his blessing to the people. He came silently. But meek souls, the people received it while Christ entered in.
nv: doo íitsʼaʼgóó, doo íitsʼaʼgóó, aadeetʼáanii aaíltį́! yáʼąąshdę́ę́ʼ god einíłtíinii diné yeidiyiiʼaah. doo íitsʼaʼígóó níyá; ndi aʼátʼeʼ biiʼ, diné dabinízingóó christ tʼahdii yah aheghááh.

en: From Bethlehem, a holy baby came upon us. He cleanses our sins. He gives life. The holy angels sing. They tell the news. May he come, be with us. We honor him.
nv: bethlehemdóó awééʼ diyin nihikʼi hooleʼ. nihaʼátʼeʼ nihąąh táánígis, iiná nihiih danlé. diyin naalʼaʼí dahataał, haneʼ yaa dahaneʼ; nihaa nínááh nihił honílǫ́, bídahwííníilníihii.

en: The holy baby came upon us from Bethlehem. He cleanses our sinfulness. He gives life. The holy angels sing, proclaiming the news. May he come, he is with us. We honor him.
nv: bethlehemdóó awééʼ diyin nihikʼi hooleʼ. nihaʼátʼeʼ nihąąh táánígis, iiná nihiih danlé. diyin naalʼaʼí dahataał, haneʼ yaa dahaneʼ; nihaa nínááh nihił honílǫ́, bídahwííníilníihii.

en: The holy child of Bethlehem came upon us. He cleanses our sins. He provides life. The heavenly hosts sing, announcing the news. May he come, he’ll be with us. We worship him.
nv: bethlehemdóó awééʼ diyin nihikʼi hooleʼ. nihaʼátʼeʼ nihąąh táánígis, iiná nihiih danlé. diyin naalʼaʼí dahataał, haneʼ yaa dahaneʼ; nihaa nínááh nihił honílǫ́, bídahwííníilníihii.

en: All of you bow down. Listen to the angels tell that Christ was born.
nv: yaa ádaahnééh diyingo ndaalʼaʼí éí deísółtsʼą́ą́ʼ christ yizhchį́ yaa dahalneʼ.
